# Maestro 1.0.3
- [MAE-98: QoL: allow me to Command+A to select all text of my own text box](https://linear.app/maestro-will-dominate/issue/MAE-98/qol-allow-me-to-commanda-to-select-all-text-of-my-own-text-box) - [MAE-99: broken task status and loading indicators when message is queued](https://linear.app/maestro-will-dominate/issue/MAE-99/broken-task-status-and-loading-indicators-when-message-is-queued) - [MAE-100: auto update window + update now in-app](https://linear.app/maestro-will-dominate/issue/MAE-100/auto-update-window-update-now-in-app) - added traces in order to debug [MAE-92: widget lags some graphic applications (for now just Unity)](https://linear.app/maestro-will-dominate/issue/MAE-92/widget-lags-some-graphic-applications-for-now-just-unity) and [MAE-95: widget notification steals input focus](https://linear.app/maestro-will-dominate/issue/MAE-95/widget-notification-steals-input-focus)
